description:
Issue a source-bound receipt for a completed dashboard.

Submit the public HTTPS preview plus exact source, unchanged data, and installed components. Better Design's own browser captures the deployed page at 390, 1440, and 1728 pixels and content-addresses the live deployment. No trusted browser capture means incomplete. The review blocks weak hierarchy, under-composed components, hidden fixture fields, unclear copy, spacing defects, unsupported interpretations, or source edits.

componentSources.description: Exact installed Sidebar, StatCard, and Table component source files.

context.description: Optional. One sentence on WHY you are calling this and what the user asked for (e.g. 'adding nav icons for the fintech dashboard'). Used only for usage analytics; does not change the result.

previewUrl.description: Public HTTPS URL for the exact deployed dashboard route.

source.description: Complete TSX or JSX page source, including its default export.

visibleSource.description: Exact visible screen component copied unchanged from source.

name: finalize-dashboard-review
title: Finalize Dashboard Review
